name: refresh_project_context
description: Re-read a repo's stack files and rewrite its PROJECT_CONTEXT.md using the current code state.

args.title: Rewrite PROJECT_CONTEXT.md for {{projectPath}}
args.description: Using the file list and stack files just read, write a fresh PROJECT_CONTEXT.md to {{projectPath}}/PROJECT_CONTEXT.md. Follow the standard template: Stack, Entry Point, Test Command, Key Directories, Constraints. Use Gemini to fill each section accurately from the actual file content.
